appDescription: A drowsiness prevention app for delivery drivers that ventilates the cabin, checks on the driver by voice, and guides to a nearby rest area.

function.name: VENT_NOW
function.description: Starts a short cabin ventilation right away by bringing in outside air and opening the windows slightly.

function.name: I_AM_FINE
function.description: Tells the app that the driver is alert in response to its check-in question.

function.name: GO_REST
function.description: Adds the nearest rest area ahead on the route as a navigation waypoint.
